I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store was Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own 9 June message in #central-team. She wrote that the Pine Crossing morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login.

#central-team has no later update on whether it was fixed, so I suggested she check with Hollis before updating the account sheet. I only used #central-team and public files, which Pree can see herself.
